clues.text: Joseph told Pharaoh that the seven thin cows meant seven years of this would follow the good years.
Abram went down to Egypt with Sarai because this had become severe in the land.
In the days of the judges, this drove Elimelech and Naomi from Bethlehem to live in Moab.
In Jesus' parable, a severe one swept the far country after the younger son spent everything.
Because of this, Isaac went to Abimelech king of the Philistines at Gerar, as in Abraham's time.
Elisha told the Shunammite woman to leave her home, for the LORD had decreed seven years of this.
Through Amos, God warned of one that was not of bread or water, but of hearing His words.
